title: Act: Add onReject prop and Reject button to ExecutionPanel
summary: Add onReject prop, canReject flag and Reject button to ExecutionPanel
description: Edit ExecutionPanel.tsx: extend ExecutionPanelProps with onReject, compute canReject, include it in the actions container condition and render the Reject button after Approve.
acceptance_criteria: Given AWAITING_APPROVAL and onReject, when rendered, then a Reject button calls onReject(id)
Given no onReject or a different status, when rendered, then no Reject button is rendered

steps.action: Add the optional prop onReject after onRetry in the ExecutionPanelProps interface.
steps.code:
onRetry?: (id: string) => void;
  onReject?: (id: string) => void;
